images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 concept image for an improved Blender-built Roblox Backrooms Level 3 section.
The supplied image is an ACTUAL current-game reference for identity, materials, cheap furniture, scale and ceiling height. Retain that identity, but design a better layered layout, more intentional visual composition and slightly richer readable textures. Do not copy the HUD or interface.
Scene: RED PARTY MAZE in a tired, affordable late-1990s suburban mall children's birthday venue after closing. Familiar plain reddish-orange painted walls with black vinyl skirting, the same distinctive gaudy mottled patterned RED carpet as the reference, very low yellowed suspended ceiling tile grid with cheap flat rectangular fluorescent fixtures. Cheap beige rectangular laminate folding tables with thin black folding metal legs and mismatched red, yellow, blue and green moulded plastic garden chairs. They must remain cheap and ordinary.
Layout: Human-eye view from one birthday room into linked offset birthday rooms through TWO large rectangular openings, with an L-turn in the middle distance and a clear walking route. Empty negative space and off-center openings make this feel like an unnerving playable maze. One modest freestanding folding room divider with beige panels and a stack of coloured plastic chairs along a wall add silhouette variety. A small tired balloon cluster beside a foreground cake table with a few paper plates, a crooked cheap paper garland, minor scuffs, faint carpet wear and old tape marks. Semi-dirty and used but maintained enough to operate, never abandoned ruins.
Lighting: slightly dim warm fluorescent foreground, readable tabletop and carpet; a far passage lit cooler off-white, one ceiling fixture turned off. Restrained everyday light, subtle horror through empty familiar space. No dramatic cinematic fog.
Style: Moderately stylized high-quality Blender indie-horror game environment concept, coherent modular boxy construction, one continuous flat walkable floor. Improved material definition and composition without turning it into an upscale venue.
Hard constraints: no people, no monsters, no HUD, no overlays, no collage, no logos. No water, wet floors, gore or apocalyptic damage. No banquet tablecloths, stage curtains, upholstered seating, velvet, arches, marble, coves, expensive lighting, luxury mall architecture, hotel lobby or fancy decorations. Preserve the unmistakable low-ceiling cheap children's-party Backrooms identity of the supplied reference.
images.assessment: Visually inspected. Low yellowed tile ceiling, plain reddish-orange walls, gaudy red carpet, cheap folding laminate table and colored plastic chairs preserve current-level identity. Two off-center openings with linked rooms, clear route, L-turn, folding divider, stacked chairs and modest party props provide improvement. Material wear moderate; no luxury architecture or HUD. One ceiling panel appears unlit/dark. Accepted.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE landscape 1536x1024 image: an improved, new small BUDGET ARCADE ROOM off the children's party maze in Roblox Backrooms Level 3, intended as a buildable Blender concept.
Input image role: ACTUAL current-game reference for the visual identity, ceiling height, flat orange walls and black wall band, dark confetti carpet and cheap plastic furniture. Its HUD must not be copied. This is a new room connected to that same affordable worn-down late-1990s mall birthday venue, not a stylish retro arcade.
Scene and layout: modest awkward rectangular room, very LOW yellowed suspended ceiling grid, cheap flat fluorescent ceiling fixtures, orange-beige flat painted boxy walls with a black lower vinyl band. Same dark multicolored confetti patterned carpet as the reference, faint flattened traffic wear. Three old ordinary CRT arcade cabinets against a side wall with worn laminate edges and generic pixel patterns on the screens. A small cheap PRIZE COUNTER with a scuffed laminate front and tiny clear plastic boxes of low-cost trinkets behind it; faded indistinct generic prize illustration poster. A single old inexpensive claw cabinet set off to the side. One folding beige laminate waiting table and two mismatched coloured moulded plastic garden chairs. This is a neighborhood mall birthday rental place for ordinary families: basic, affordable, slightly tacky.
Composition: believable human-eye game view, center floor open and navigable. Show a wide plain rectangular opening that clearly connects back to the current orange children's birthday party room with cheap tables and multicoloured plastic chairs visible through it. A plain staff-only-looking service door near the prize counter, no readable required wording. Mildly awkward offsets and an exposed retrofitted electrical conduit establish the place.
Materials and light: moderately scuffed walls, patches of old adhesive, dusty vent, slightly faded plastics, a few old maintenance patches. Semi-dirty but still a functioning venue, not derelict. Flat warm off-white fluorescent ceiling light dominates; just very subtle CRT glow, softly dim far party room. Enough light to clearly read the cabinets, walkway and furniture.
Style: refined moderately stylized Blender indie horror environment concept with good material definition and layout, boxy modular game-buildable shapes, one flat walkable floor. Empty uneasy late-night backrooms atmosphere without theatrical horror effects.
Hard constraints: no people, characters, HUD, text overlay, collage, logos or known game IP. No neon club, cyberpunk, LED strips, luxury lounge, posh mall, glossy showroom, giant jukebox, marble, velvet, dramatic colored spotlights, curved designer architecture, fancy scenery. No water/wet floors/gore/extreme neglect or apocalyptic damage. Keep it humble and ordinary like the exact reference, improve the environment craft, not the social class of the venue.
images.assessment: Visually inspected. Three worn CRT cabinets, modest prize counter, claw cabinet, staff door, exposed conduit and low fluorescent ceiling create a new room consistent with original orange/black party area. Opening visibly connects to folding tables and colored chairs. Dark confetti carpet and scuffed cheap materials retained. No neon club styling, luxury finishes, HUD or people. Accepted.
